records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A paid non-cancellable reservation from a target MSP with disclosed fee, capacity, and data-access terms, followed by pilot measurements of baseline versus achieved review labor, cycle time, supplier completion, connector hours, exception cost, contribution margin, utilization, and renewal intent; comparable win-loss evidence against incumbent or internal alternatives is also needed.
records.primary_score_limiter: The same uncommitted MSP relationship is simultaneously the demand proof, distribution channel, workflow and data-access gate, pricing basis, and initial revenue concentration, while no unit economics or repeatable second-partner route has been established.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: ProcessUnity already offers one-assessment/share-many reuse, and Whistic, OneTrust, Vanta, and Drata already provide overlapping evidence exchange, questionnaires, inventories, monitoring, and reassessment, supporting a credible incumbent-bundling threat and weakening claims of a distinctive product advantage.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A time-bounded pilot should report the full funnel for real battery or inverter faults: owner record activation and consent, qualified-case rate, provider acceptance, paid completion, time to resolution, average basket and realised fee, technician-review cost, support and dispute cost, refunds or insurance cost, contribution margin, repeat provider use, and equivalent results from at least one provider channel independent of the family company.
records.primary_score_limiter: The business needs high recurring transaction volume to overcome low revenue per job and human-intensive orchestration, yet neither external case supply nor contribution economics has been demonstrated and the stated wealth path requires about 55,804 completed transactions per year.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: SolarPlus, InsTool, and Payaca already bundle handover records and customer portals, while SolarEdge binds sites and serials to installer accounts; this demonstrates that the core record function is already available inside entrenched workflows and weakens the premise that portability alone will generate switching or service-case flow.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Paid pilots from multiple independent PPG teams at the proposed price, measured delivery margin and acquisition effort, documented cases where the gate changes a release decision or saves meaningful validation time, at least two later-version repurchases, a repeatable qualified-introduction channel, and signed terms permitting lawful reuse of derived failure features would materially improve the judgment.
records.primary_score_limiter: The combination of an unproven narrow buyer pool, project-based revenue, uncertain repeat frequency, and unvalidated acquisition leaves no credible route yet from a useful specialist audit to scalable owner earnings or a dominant position.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Adjacent buyers can already access a Labfront audit starting at USD 500, established research platforms and ECG/PPG simulators, plus openly licensed reference-labelled datasets, showing both a materially lower price anchor and credible build-or-buy substitutes for a standalone gate.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Paid batches from multiple unrelated O&M firms or lessors showing minimum efficient batch size, record-complete and contract-eligible rates, screen-to-test and test-to-manufacturer-acceptance rates, verified recovery or avoided-cost value, resolution time, fully loaded labor/legal/testing/insurance cost, contribution margin, partner CAC/payback, and repeat submissions after the first batch.
records.primary_score_limiter: The business has no evidence that unrelated partners can supply enough record-complete, contract-eligible, economically valuable cases per batch to sustain the proposed price, margin, repeat rate, and founder-wealth path.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Polish providers already bundle monitoring with manufacturer-warranty handling at low monthly prices, while commercial contract exclusions, manufacturer proof burdens, and costly disconfirming tests can eliminate recovery; this weakens both differentiated willingness to pay and the density of monetizable cases.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A paid MSP design partnership should show customer permission to reuse evidence, supplier completion and renewal rates, documented review hours saved, clean import or export with incumbent systems, acceptable liability and security terms, and a first-year fee repaid within 12 months without bespoke support.
records.primary_score_limiter: The product depends on an unvalidated MSP channel while offering capabilities that established GRC and security-exchange vendors already bundle, leaving weak evidence of a durable reason to adopt a small overlay.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: ProcessUnity explicitly offers one assessment shared with multiple customers, while Whistic, OneTrust, Vanta, and Drata cover the surrounding inventory, questionnaire, evidence, monitoring, and reassessment workflows.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A paid operator-controlled offline study should deliver an out-of-time benchmark against the incumbent process, subgroup false-positive and false-negative results, measured reviewer hours and intervention outcomes, a written licensing-perimeter opinion and DPIA, and a platform or operator commitment with acceptable annual price, support scope, and payback.
records.primary_score_limiter: Validation and deployment require privileged operator data and platform cooperation in a high-stakes environment where a major incumbent already sells the central capability and the founder cannot support live operations alone.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Playtech's BetBuddy already provides predictive safer-gambling analytics and intervention support, while published studies show material indicator drift and threshold sensitivity rather than a stable universal classifier.
